answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits in escrow for a marble bench and names a sponsor in its referral graph. The bench sits in a river delta, its edges public. A ferrous assay tag binds bench to key. Peers may dispute a referral; auditors check the graph for star clusters and re-assay the bench, and a fake burns the bond. First 45, kth 45+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented referrals share sponsors; honest pay 45 once.
